phase3_obligation.statement: ∀ {State : Type} [Finite State] (na : NA.Buchi State Symbol), ∃ (dm : DA.Muller (Quotient na.BuchiCongruence.eq) Symbol), language dm = language na

dma_spec.transition: δ([u], a) = [u ++ [a]] (right multiplication in the congruence quotient)
dma_spec.accept_set: {S : Set Q | ∃ b : Q, b ∈ S ∧ (⟦[]⟧, b) ∈ good_pairs na} where good_pairs na = {(a,b) | (na.buchiFamily (a,b) ∩ language na).Nonempty}

language_eq_proof_ingredients: buchiFamily_saturation (na := na) : Saturates (fun i => (na.buchiFamily i).toSet) (language na).toSet
buchiFamily_component_isRegular : each na.buchiFamily i is ω-regular

continuation_context.key_challenge: Constructing the explicit DA.Muller record with the correct transition function (as a Quotient-valued function) and the accept set expressed as a Set (Set Q). The hardest part is proving language equality using the saturation machinery.
relevant_lemmas: Quotient.liftOn or Quotient.ind for the transition function

next_action_hint: Phase 3: implement h_pkg by constructing the DA.Muller record. Key first step: define the transition function δ : Quotient na.BuchiCongruence.eq → Symbol → Quotient na.BuchiCongruence.eq as δ(q, a) = Quotient.map (· ++ [a]) (congruence_right_cov) q. Then define accept set. Then prove language equality using buchiFamily_saturation + saturates_eq_biUnion + buchiFamily_cover.
